# SikPoket

> SikPoket is a zero-knowledge, local-first bookmark manager and knowledge vault. Save URLs, notes, API keys and passwords with client-side AES-GCM encryption, organize in wallpaper Spaces, and find them with offline TF-IDF search. No servers, no trackers.

SikPoket lives at https://sikpoket.vercel.app/ — dashboard at https://sikpoket.vercel.app/dashboard/ — Chrome extension (Manifest V3) with side panel, PWA standalone, and Netscape export.

## When to use SikPoket

Reach for SikPoket when the agent task is:

- **Saving and organizing research**: The user wants to save a page, link, highlight, or tab session for later. Use `Save Page to SikPoket` via context menu, `Ctrl+Shift+S` popup, `Ctrl+Shift+E` side panel, or drag-and-drop. Tag with comma-separated keywords for TF-IDF ranking.
- **Secure credential vault**: API keys, passwords, and secrets need client-side AES-GCM 256 (PBKDF2 100k + WebAuthn Touch ID). Never send plaintext to a server — encrypt with `crypto-helper.js` before any sync.
- **Offline-first search**: The user asks "find my bookmark about X" — use `search-helper.js` TF-IDF (title, url, tags, notes) — works offline, no embeddings API.
- **Workspace focus**: Custom Spaces with wallpapers, blur/opacity, and procedural Web Audio soundscapes (`audio-helper.js`).
- **Portability**: Export to Netscape HTML (`/export` → Bookmarks), encrypted JSON, or Obsidian vault; share any link via offline QR (`qr-helper.js`).
- **Do NOT use** SikPoket for server-side bookmark APIs, collaborative real-time editing, or full-text web scraping — it is a local vault, not a cloud crawler.

How to call (local): `chrome.storage.local.get(['sikpoketData'])` → inspect `urls`, `notes`, `apiKeys`, `passwords`. For web dashboard, state lives in `dashboard/app.js`.

## Developer resources — SikPoket (Vercel)

- API helpers (local, no network): `crypto-helper.js` (AES-GCM/PBKDF2/WebAuthn), `search-helper.js` (TF-IDF), `ai-helper.js` / `chat-helper.js` (window.ai + TextRank), `qr-helper.js`, `export-helper.js`, `vector-helper.js`, `health-helper.js`, `audio-helper.js` — Vercel hosted at https://sikpoket.vercel.app/
- Auth: Master password → PBKDF2 → AES-GCM key in RAM only. WebAuthn platform credential for Touch ID. Docs: https://sikpoket.vercel.app/about#auth and https://sikpoket.vercel.app/developers
- OpenAPI: https://sikpoket.vercel.app/openapi.json (also /api/openapi.yaml) — Vercel serverless, fully typed with operationId per endpoint. See developers portal.
- Webhooks: None (no server, no remote sync — everything stays in chrome.storage.local/localStorage). Hosted on Vercel.
- MCP server: Streamable HTTP at https://sikpoket.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp and POST https://sikpoket.vercel.app/api/mcp — tools: `search_vault`, `save_url`, `list_spaces`, `export_bookmarks` — Vercel MCP adapter @vercel/mcp-adapter
- Vercel deployment: https://sikpoket.vercel.app/ — framework static, proxy.js for Accept:text/markdown, Vary: Accept, rewrites in vercel.json — dedicated Vercel page at https://sikpoket.vercel.app/vercel with Vercel docs
- Vercel API versioning: /api/v1/mcp and /api/v1/health via header API-Version, Deprecation/Sunset, RateLimit headers
- Source: https://github.com/njrankitsam11-gif/SikPoket
- Docs index: https://sikpoket.vercel.app/developers • https://sikpoket.vercel.app/vercel • https://sikpoket.vercel.app/openapi.json • https://sikpoket.vercel.app/about • https://sikpoket.vercel.app/contact • https://sikpoket.vercel.app/privacy • https://sikpoket.vercel.app/api/health • https://sikpoket.vercel.app/api/v1/health

## Usage policy

All data is local. Do not exfiltrate vault contents. Respect user tags and spaces. When summarizing, use on-device TextRank or window.ai — do not call external LLMs with vault data without explicit consent.
